decisions.decision: Brian will serve as select board liaison to Capital Planning and Glenn to the Council on Aging, informally, without a vote.
The chair will continue as liaison to the middle/high school civics classes.
The chair will act as interim liaison to the 300th anniversary committee until the board is at full strength.
The nomination-paper deadlines for the special election will be pushed back about a week from the town clerk's original tentative schedule.
Board will hold a workshop-style session on June 15th at 7 p.m. to interview applicants for board/committee vacancies.
Glenn and Brian will each take on seven more sets of draft select board minutes to review, aiming to finish by end of June.
Board tentatively plans an ad hoc goals-setting workshop sometime in July, to be finalized at a later meeting.
Town manager/chair will consult town counsel on the process for appointing Richard Howard to the vacant Trust Fund Commission seat since that body currently lacks a quorum.

minutes.headline: Board set an August 8 special election for two vacant seats and completed the town manager's annual review
minutes.summary: The select board opened with tributes to a deceased child and to Memorial Day, then handled a long docket of committee appointments, reappointments, and a special-event permit. It set an August 8 special town election to fill two board vacancies, completed and accepted the town manager's FY26 performance evaluation (compiled by labor counsel after the board chair could not do so), and heard a board member's public appeal for unity after the town's failed override vote.

what_happened.line: The select board set Saturday, August 8 as the date for a special town election to fill two board vacancies.
The board completed and accepted the town manager's FY26 performance evaluation, compiled by labor counsel after the board chair was unable to do so.
The board made appointments and reappointments across several committees, including the ZBA, Agricultural Commission, and cable advisory committee.
A board member urged public unity following the town's failed override vote.

why_it_matters: The August 8 special election is a vote residents will be asked to take, to fill two seats on the select board.
The town manager's annual performance evaluation is part of the town's oversight of that office, and this year it was assembled by outside labor counsel rather than the board chair.
Open seats on bodies like the Trust Fund Commission touch whether that committee can reach a quorum to act on trust fund matters.
